g.text: Candidate match score: 25.0%. Its benchmark value MSE remains worse than always predicting zero. Retain the supervised baseline.

g.text: Value targets are outcomes of the frozen supervised baseline playing exploratory self-play, not perfect-play evaluations.

text.style: font-size: 9.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #596a76

g.text: Matches use 64 simulations per move for both models, fresh roots, deterministic choices, and no exploration noise.

text.style: font-size: 9.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #596a76

g.text: Value accuracy, human imitation, and playing strength are distinct. One small paired match set does not establish an Elo rating.
